rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND ((EventID=11 AND (TargetFilename LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\remcos\\logs%.dat%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetFilename LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\remcos\\logs.dat%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=13 AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Remcos%exepath%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Rmc-%exepath%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\run%remcos%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Joe Security
description: Powershell delayed execution via ping command
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%ping -n % & powershell.exe -executionpolicy bypass -noninteractive -windowstyle hidden%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Powershell delayed execution via ping command

author: Joe Security

author: Joe Security

author: Joe Security
